channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Police back National Police Service plan, urge safeguards
item.description: Senior policing bodies have publicly supported the government proposal to create a National Police Service, while stressing that the reform must preserve strong links with local forces and communities. The post Police back National Police Service plan, urge safeguards first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Norway considers reducing Type 26 Frigate purchase
item.description: Norwegian defence planners are considering reducing the number of new Type 26 frigates purchased from the UK from five to three. The post Norway considers reducing Type 26 Frigate purchase first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Shipbuilding debate raises yard access and fraud concerns
item.description: Ministers faced questions over naval shipbuilding, with MPs pressing on export claims, access for domestic yards, foreign suppliers and the impact of fraud. The post Shipbuilding debate raises yard access and fraud concerns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Mini sonobuoys being developed for uncrewed systems
item.description: The Royal Navy is moving to expand its undersea surveillance reach through the development of miniaturised sonobuoys designed for use with uncrewed air systems, as part of a wider shift towards more autonomous anti-submarine warfare capabilities. The post Mini sonobuoys being developed for uncrewed systems first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Warship downs drone swarm off British coast in exercise
item.description: Dutch warship Evertsen tracked and neutralised aerial targets while also engaging and sinking uncrewed surface vessels as part of Exercise Sharpshooter. The post Warship downs drone swarm off British coast in exercise first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain terminates plan to buy new autonomous survey vessel
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has formally terminated plans to procure an uncrewed surface vessel under Project Lily, bringing an end to a programme that had been expected to deliver a contractor-supported autonomous platform for survey work. The post Britain terminates plan to buy new autonomous survey vessel first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American warship downs drones with laser weapon
item.description: The US Navy has confirmed that a frontline destroyer has successfully used a ship-mounted laser weapon to defeat multiple uncrewed aerial threats during a recent at-sea demonstration. The post American warship downs drones with laser weapon first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American supercarrier shoots down Iranian drone
item.description: The United States Navy has shot down an Iranian drone that approached a US aircraft carrier operating in the Gulf, according to reporting by Reuters. The post American supercarrier shoots down Iranian drone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK denies F-35 kill switch claim despite US reliance
item.description: Ministers deny any US kill switch on UK F-35s, but the jets remain tightly bound to American software, data and sustainment systems that ultimately shape how freely they can be used over time. The post UK denies F-35 kill switch claim despite US reliance first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No numbers yet on plan for new Atlantic drone ships
item.description: The Royal Navy has not yet set targets for the number of uncrewed surface or underwater vessels it may deploy in the Arctic or North Atlantic. The post No numbers yet on plan for new Atlantic drone ships first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
